summary: Short arterial kerb at an intersection corner, apartments 10 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Landon House 10 m and another apartment block 11 m away; homes all round.

drivers.convention: Signs limit stopping to 2P and no stopping 4-6:30pm; no overnight use.

best_section.where: south kerb of Sir Fred Schonell Drive at the Durham Street corner
